summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive add_to_cbd helper that applies the three CBD rules, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion in reification, blank-node cycles, and source-graph immutability. Nothing was run, per instructions; tests and flake8 are still unverified. Fixtures are my own, not the reference fixtures, so the spec's 8-triple blank-node case is not reproduced. No commit was made.
